disco elysium: the final cut.name: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut
disco elysium: the final cut.short_description: Disco Elysium - The Final Cut is a groundbreaking role playing game. You’re a detective with a unique skill system at your disposal and a whole city to carve your path across. Interrogate unforgettable characters, crack murders or take bribes. Become a hero or an absolute disaster of a human being.

tetris effect: connected.name: Tetris® Effect: Connected
tetris effect: connected.short_description: Tetris® Effect: Connected adds an all-new robust multiplayer expansion to the huge variety of addictive and innovative single-player modes that Tetris Effect is known for, with all-new co-op and competitive online and local multiplayer modes!

forza horizon 5.name: Forza Horizon 5
forza horizon 5.short_description: Explore the vibrant open world landscapes of Mexico with limitless, fun driving action in the world’s greatest cars.

chicory: a colorful tale.name: Chicory: A Colorful Tale
chicory: a colorful tale.short_description: A top-down adventure game in a coloring book world full of vibrant characters. Use painting powers to explore, solve puzzles, make friends, and draw on anything! From creators on Wandersong + Celeste.

civilization ii.name: Sid Meier's Civilization® III Complete
civilization ii.short_description: Sid Meier's Civilization III: Complete, the latest offering in the Sid Meier's Civilization III franchise, provides gaming fans with Sid Meier's Civilization III, the highly-addictive journey of discovery.

zork: nemesis.name: Zork Nemesis: The Forbidden Lands
zork: nemesis.short_description: Travel through five mind-bending worlds to discover the ancient secret of Alchemy that will free the trapped souls from evil’s grip…Do you dare enter the Forbidden Lands?

meridian 59.name: Meridian 59
meridian 59.short_description: Meridian 59 was the first 3D massively multiplayer game, released in 1996. It's back, and it's free to play!

drowned god.name: Drowned God: Conspiracy of the Ages.
drowned god.short_description: The original 90's Myst style Adventure Game featuring pre rendered graphics, intricate puzzle solving and step through exploration, exactly as it was first released in 1996 but with the post launch patches added. 'Extras' include the original pitch document, pre production art and loads more.

area 51.name: AREA 51
area 51.short_description: Storm AREA 51 with your friends. Explore the most classified facility on earth. Discover what they've been hiding. Take selfies with aliens and smuggle evidence out before the military arrives.

ignition.name: Sulfur Ignition
ignition.short_description: Sulfur Ignition is an irreverent racing game set in hell where players are condemned to compete at high speeds while battling each other, the game contains a good mix of high speed action, dark humor and lots of sarcasm!

dungeon keeper.name: Dungeon Keeper™ 2
dungeon keeper.short_description: Bad guys have all the fun. Discover your dark side as you build an evil underground kingdom and defend it against the forces of good.

diablo.name: Diablo® IV
diablo.short_description: Join the fight for Sanctuary in Diablo® IV, the ultimate action RPG adventure. Experience the critically acclaimed campaign and new seasonal content.

star wars jedi knight: dark forces ii.name: STAR WARS™ Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II
star wars jedi knight: dark forces ii.short_description: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II picks up where the award-winning Dark Forces™ game left off...with even more features and firepower in dazzling 3D graphics. As Kyle Katarn, you must acquire a lightsaber and learn the ways of the Force to become a Jedi Knight.

fallout.name: Fallout 76
fallout.short_description: Bethesda Game Studios welcome you to Fallout 76. Twenty-five years after the bombs fall, you and your fellow Vault Dwellers emerge into post-nuclear America. Explore a vast wasteland in this open-world multiplayer addition to the Fallout story.

carmageddon.name: Carmageddon: Rogue Shift
carmageddon.short_description: Carmageddon smashes back with brutal roguelite vehicular‑combat mayhem. Adapt, upgrade, and unleash destruction on post‑apocalyptic zombie hordes. The legacy lives on, reinvented and unforgiving.

mdk.name: MDK 2
mdk.short_description: 3 Unlikely Heroes, 1 Ultimate Goal Kurt Hectic is back to save the universe. This time he is teamed with the genius Dr. Hawkins and the 6-legged gun-toting robotic dog, Max. Together they must out-sneak, out-blast and out-think their enemies as they attempt to reclaim earth from a vile alien menace.

the curse of monkey island.name: The Curse of Monkey Island
the curse of monkey island.short_description: The only pirate adventure that asks the question: What's sharper, your sword or your wit?

total annihilation.name: Total Annihilation
total annihilation.short_description: What began as a conflict over the transfer of consciousness from flesh to machines escalated into a war which has decimated a million worlds. The Core and the Arm have all but exhausted the resources of a galaxy in their struggle for domination.

oddworld: abe's oddysee.name: Oddworld: Abe's Oddysee®
oddworld: abe's oddysee.short_description: Selected by the fickle finger of fate, Abe™, floor-waxer first class for RuptureFarms, was catapulted into a life of adventure when he overheard plans by his boss, Molluck the Glukkon™, to turn Abe and his fellow Mudokons into Tasty Treats as part of a last-ditch effort to rescue Molluck's failing meat-packing empire.

independence day.name: Secret Cats - Independence Day
independence day.short_description: Dive into the enchanting world of "Secret Cats - Independence Day" a hidden object game where your mission is to uncover every cat hidden within stunning hand-painted artwork. Let your keen eye and curiosity guide you through this captivating journey.

the last express.name: The Last Express Gold Edition
the last express.short_description: Step aboard the 1914 Orient Express in this award-winning mystery adventure from Prince of Persia creator Jordan Mechner. Described as one of the best adventure games of all time, The Last Express is an intrigue-filled adventure set aboard the luxurious Orient Express.

outlaws.name: Star Wars Outlaws
outlaws.short_description: Experience the first-ever open world Star Wars™ game and explore distinct locations across the galaxy, both iconic and new. Risk it all as scoundrel Kay Vess, seeking freedom and the means to start a new life.

redneck rampage.name: Redneck Rampage
redneck rampage.short_description: Well, we crash-landed that UFO in the desert and Bubba says he wants to go home. Heck, I don't blame him 'cause there ain't no place like Hickston. But according to my map, we're gonna have to blast our way through jack o' lope farms and a riverboat as well as a brothel 'fore we get home again.

star wars: x-wing vs. tie fighter.name: STAR WARS™ X-Wing vs TIE Fighter - Balance of Power Campaigns™
star wars: x-wing vs. tie fighter.short_description: Real-time against real pilots; this is Star Wars space combat as it was meant to be! Featuring challenging real-time dogfights of 2 to 8 players, Star Wars™: X-Wing vs. TIE Fighter is one of the most historically significant space combat simulators ever made.

blood.name: The Blood of Dawnwalker
blood.short_description: The Blood of Dawnwalker is an open-world dark fantasy action RPG set in 14th-century Europe. You play as Coen, human by day and vampire by night, fighting to save your family in a story shaped by your actions and the secrets you uncover.

ecstatica ii.name: Ecstatica II
ecstatica ii.short_description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

shadow warrior.name: Shadow Warrior
shadow warrior.short_description: Shadow Warrior is a bold reimagining of the classic 3D Realms’ shooter from independent developer Flying Wild Hog (Hard Reset) starring the legendary and quick-witted warrior Lo Wang.

imperialism.name: Imperialism: Concert of Europe
imperialism.short_description: It is the 19th century - an age of steam power, revolution, and imperialist expansion. Engage in turn-based gameplay as you strive to ascend to unparalleled power through astute management of trade, industry, research, diplomacy, colonization, and warfare.

star wars: shadows of the empire.name: STAR WARS™ SHADOWS OF THE EMPIRE™
star wars: shadows of the empire.short_description: As Luke Skywalker and the Rebel Alliance struggle to defeat Darth Vader and the Empire, a new threat arises. Dark Prince Xizor aspires to take Darth Vader's place at the Emperor's side. As Dash Rendar, it's up to you to protect Luke and help the Alliance. May the Force be with you!

hexen ii.name: HeXen II
hexen ii.short_description: The Four Horsemen of the Apocalypse lurk in the shadows before you. They are Death, Pestilence, Famine, and War. They are the root of all that is evil, but the least of your worries. The last of the three Serpent Riders yet lives.

resident evil.name: Resident Evil 4
resident evil.short_description: Survival is just the beginning. Six years have passed since the biological disaster in Raccoon City. Leon S. Kennedy, one of the survivors, tracks the president's kidnapped daughter to a secluded European village, where there is something terribly wrong with the locals.

ultima online.name: Ultimate Fishing® Online
ultima online.short_description: Ultimate Fishing® Online is a free-to-play multiplayer fishing game set in ecosystems with various fish, reactive shoals, dynamic weather & day-night cycles. Explore diverse fishing spots, customize gear & use various techniques! Cast, Catch & Compete!

postal.name: POSTAL 2
postal.short_description: Live a week in the life of "The POSTAL Dude"; a hapless everyman just trying to check off some chores. Buying milk, returning an overdue library book, getting Gary Coleman's autograph, what could possibly go wrong?

croc: legend of the gobbos.name: Croc Legend of the Gobbos
croc: legend of the gobbos.short_description: Join Croc in a charming 3D platforming adventure to rescue the kidnapped Gobbos from the evil sorcerer Baron Dante and his impish Dantini minions! Run, jump, climb, swim, and tail-spin through vibrant worlds in this lovingly remastered and updated version of the beloved 1997 classic.

combat chess.name: Combat Chess
combat chess.short_description: Play with living, battling characters! Combat Chess takes the basic chess game and adds an imaginative element for players. Beautifully done in rendered 3D graphics, Combat Chess adds stunning animation sequences during gameplay.

age of empires.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
age of empires.short_description: 42 Civilizations, 229 Campaign Missions, Singleplayer, Co-Op, Multiplayer, In-Game Editor, Mods, Cross-play...It is good to be the king.

riven.name: Riven
riven.short_description: Uncover a story of intrigue, betrayal, and a civilization teetering on the brink of collapse as you solve intricate puzzles to unlock the secrets of Riven. Built from the ground-up and expanded from the award-winning original game released in 1997.

zork: grand inquisitor.name: Zork: Grand Inquisitor
zork: grand inquisitor.short_description: Join forces with Dungeon Master Dalboz and travel throughout the Underground Empire's many locations, such as Hades, Flood Control Dam #3 and The Dungeon Master's Lair.

independence war.name: Independence War® 2: Edge of Chaos
independence war.short_description: Command four space vessels and a band of revolutionary pirates into an all-consuming battle against impossible odds, because there just isn't enough Space for everyone!

blade runner.name: Blade Runner: Enhanced Edition
blade runner.short_description: Armed with your investigative skills and the tools of the Blade Runner trade, you'll be immersed in a world that lives and breathes around you with breakthrough lighting and visual effects. Your ability to survive will be put to the test in the richest game environment ever created.

tomb raider ii.name: Tomb Raider II (1997)
tomb raider ii.short_description: The second instalment in the Tomb Raider series invites you to join Lara as she travels around the globe to retrieve a precious artefact before it falls into the wrong hands. The legendary artefact, the Dagger of Xian, is said to give its possessor the power of a fire breathing dragon.

grand theft auto.name: Grand Theft Auto V Enhanced
grand theft auto.short_description: Experience entertainment blockbusters Grand Theft Auto V and Grand Theft Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for GTA Online players.

quake ii.name: Quake II
quake ii.short_description: You are humanity’s last hope to stop the Strogg, a hostile alien race waging war against Earth. Play this military sci-fi FPS, now upgraded for modern platforms with improved visuals, new campaign content, online multiplayer/co-op, and more.

7 wonders.name: 7 Wonders II
7 wonders.short_description: Journey back in time with the 7 Wonders series to when magnificent structures were being built in far away lands. Enjoy challenging match-3 gameplay in a newly enhanced interactive environment where you not only learn about marvelous new wonders such as Stonehenge and Taj Mahal, but also watch them come to life piece by piece before your...

homeworld.name: Homeworld Remastered Collection
homeworld.short_description: Experience the epic space strategy games that redefined the RTS genre. Control your fleet and build an armada across more than 30 single-player missions. Choose unit types, fleet formations and flight tactics for each strategic situation.

system shock 2.name: System Shock 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster
system shock 2.short_description: System Shock® 2: 25th Anniversary Remaster is a genre defining experience that established innovative game-play mechanics that are a staple of the FPS and RPG genre today. Survive the wretched corridors of the Von Braun. Your training has prepared you for this.

sid meier's alpha centauri.name: Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri™ Planetary Pack
sid meier's alpha centauri.short_description: Sid Meier's Alpha Centauri™ Planetary Pack includes the original Alpha Centauri and the expansion, Alien Crossfire.

age of empires ii.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition
age of empires ii.short_description: 42 Civilizations, 229 Campaign Missions, Singleplayer, Co-Op, Multiplayer, In-Game Editor, Mods, Cross-play...It is good to be the king.

freespace 2.name: Freespace 2
freespace 2.short_description: FreeSpace 2, the follow up to the classic Descent: FreeSpace – The Great War is ready to engage you in the second round. Follow the Grand Terran Vasudan Alliance further into the mysteries of the Shivans. Get your flight stick and hit the flight deck. The last time was just a warm up.

planescape: torment.name: Planescape: Torment: Enhanced Edition
planescape: torment.short_description: Uncover secrets of past lives in this story-rich, tactical roleplaying game set in Sigil, a dark fantasy city at the heart of the Dungeons & Dragons multiverse. Explore the planes, survive combat alongside a party of bizarre companions, and solve puzzles unlike any ever seen in the genre.

legacy of kain: soul reaver.name: Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver 2 (2001)
legacy of kain: soul reaver.short_description: In this sequel to the critically acclaimed Legacy of Kain: Soul Reaver, reassume the role of Raziel, and travel back through the currents of time into various eras of Nosgoth's past in your relentless pursuit of Kain.

the longest journey.name: The Longest Journey
the longest journey.short_description: The Longest Journey is an amazing graphical adventure, where the player controls the protagonist, April Ryan, on her journey between parallel universes.

descent 3.name: Descent 3
descent 3.short_description: The vertigo continues as the highly anticipated sequel to Descent I and II takes the mind-bending, pulse-pounding experience to another level!

worms armageddon.name: Worms Armageddon
worms armageddon.short_description: The iconic intrepid invertebrates return with a vengeance in the fan-favourite classic Worms™ Armageddon. Relive their glory days once again as you blast your way into enemy territory, sweep their fields and remain the last worm standing.

everquest.name: EverQuest
everquest.short_description: Welcome to EverQuest® - the original fantasy MMORPG. Explore huge worlds, fight challenging foes, and grow your character with friends. Discover why players have quested, grouped, and raided in Norrath for more than two decades.

driver.name: Thank You Bus Driver
driver.short_description: Take on the role of a town’s rules-driven (and reckless) bus driver in Thank You Bus Driver! Drive fast, slap faster, and toss any rulebreakers out of your bus to reach true victory: being appreciated.

rollercoaster tycoon.name: RollerCoaster Tycoon® 3: Complete Edition
rollercoaster tycoon.short_description: Build the park of a lifetime and rediscover the critically acclaimed rollercoaster simulation bestseller. Feel the thrill of a genre-defining classic, complete with two huge expansion packs.

simcity 3000.name: SimCity™ 3000 Unlimited
simcity 3000.short_description: SimCity 3000 Unlimited brings you the classic strategy gaming of SimCity 3000 with all-new scenarios that open up a whole world of city planning and building possibilities! The thrills of the classic SimCity 3000 are here again!

star wars: x-wing alliance.name: STAR WARS™ - X-Wing Alliance™
star wars: x-wing alliance.short_description: A neutral family fights for its business - and its survival - and is swept up in the struggle against the encroaching Empire. You must defy the strong-arm tactics of a rival family who will stop at nothing to destroy your trading company.

heroes of might and magic iii.name: Heroes of Might and Magic III Remake
heroes of might and magic iii.short_description: Rediscover the critically acclaimed turn-based strategy classic and its two expansions, faithfully rebuilt in full 3D and 4K. Explore a vibrant fantasy world and lead mighty heroes in epic battles.

team fortress classic.name: Team Fortress Classic
team fortress classic.short_description: One of the most popular online action games of all time, Team Fortress Classic features over nine character classes -- from Medic to Spy to Demolition Man -- enlisted in a unique style of online team warfare. Each character class possesses unique weapons, items, and abilities, as teams compete online in a variety of game play modes.

warzone 2100.name: Warzone 2100
warzone 2100.short_description: In the late 21st century, the world's civilizations are wiped out by a series of nuclear strikes, seemingly caused by a massive malfunction of the new NASDA (North American Strategic Defense Agency) strategic defense system.

aliens versus predator.name: Aliens versus Predator Classic 2000
aliens versus predator.short_description: Aliens Versus Predator Classic 2000 features the Colonial Marine, Alien and Predator Campaigns and the frenetic single-player Skirmish mode from the original title: Alien Versus Predator Gold Edition, which was released to massive acclaim in 2000.

counter-strike.name: Counter-Strike 2
counter-strike.short_description: For over two decades, Counter-Strike has offered an elite competitive experience, one shaped by millions of players from across the globe. And now the next chapter in the CS story is about to begin. This is Counter-Strike 2.

dungeon keeper 2.name: Dungeon Keeper™ 2
dungeon keeper 2.short_description: Bad guys have all the fun. Discover your dark side as you build an evil underground kingdom and defend it against the forces of good.

jagged alliance 2.name: Jagged Alliance 2 - Wildfire
jagged alliance 2.short_description: Even if the regime is totally inept and corrupt, don't suppose for a moment that you as the liberator will be greeted with open arms.JAGGED ALLIANCE 2: WILDFIRE brings you back to Arulco. The population is being terrorized by a reckless army; in the meantime the main export goods are drugs.
